the-fool.title: The Innocent / The Beginner
the-fool.meaning: Pure potential before the story begins — courage wearing casual clothes, the willingness to move before you’re ready.
the-fool.shadow: Recklessness, avoidance of consequence, refusing to grow up.

the-magician.title: The Alchemist / The Craftsman
the-magician.meaning: Mastery over mystery — what exists inside you is sufficient for what is required outside you; nothing was ever absent.
the-magician.shadow: Manipulation, using power to control others, all skill and no soul.

the-high-priestess.title: The Oracle / The Keeper of Secrets
the-high-priestess.meaning: The space between words, the pause before the answer — wisdom deposited quietly in the body, in dreams, in the moments just before sleep.
the-high-priestess.shadow: Secrets kept to maintain power, withdrawal as avoidance, coldness mistaken for wisdom.

the-empress.title: The Mother / The Creative Force
the-empress.meaning: Abundance as a state of being, not a reward — sensual, generous, completely at home in the body; stop earning your ease and simply inhabit it.
the-empress.shadow: Smothering, over-giving until empty, mistaking abundance for love.

the-emperor.title: The Father / The Architect
the-emperor.meaning: Power earned through showing up and living with consequences — not dominance, but reliability; the structure that lets others move freely within it.
the-emperor.shadow: Rigidity, control masquerading as protection, love expressed only through authority.

the-hierophant.title: The Teacher / The Tradition-Keeper
the-hierophant.meaning: The long memory of what has been learned — the difference between inherited belief and chosen belief; what do you actually know to be true?
the-hierophant.shadow: Dogma, following rules out of fear, teaching what you don’t believe.

the-lovers.title: The Union / The Choice
the-lovers.meaning: A crossroads between versions of yourself — every real choice asks which self this path calls forward, and whether that is the one you want to be.
the-lovers.shadow: Choosing based on fear, giving yourself up to keep the peace, mistaking chemistry for compatibility.

the-chariot.title: The Victor / The Willful One
the-chariot.meaning: Directed force — holding opposing tensions long enough to drive them forward together; victory is not the absence of conflict but its intelligent use.
the-chariot.shadow: Forcing outcomes, confusing momentum with direction, winning the wrong thing.

strength.title: The Gentle Brave / The Tamer
strength.meaning: Befriending the lion, not subduing it — the quiet, consistent refusal to be ruled by fear or rage; power that doesn’t grip, it holds.
strength.shadow: Repression disguised as strength, enduring what should be refused, losing yourself to keep others comfortable.

the-hermit.title: The Seeker / The Lantern-Bearer
the-hermit.meaning: A lantern that lights only a few steps ahead — internal reckoning, the deep solitude that is not loneliness but discernment.
the-hermit.shadow: Isolation as avoidance, wisdom hoarded rather than shared, mistaking withdrawal for enlightenment.

wheel-of-fortune.title: The Turning / The Cyclic Truth
wheel-of-fortune.meaning: You are not stuck — you are in motion; fate is real, but so is the stance you take toward it.
wheel-of-fortune.shadow: Fatalism, abdicating responsibility by calling everything fate, refusing to act because it’s all up to the universe.

justice.title: The Adjudicator / The Honest Mirror
justice.meaning: Seeing clearly, not cruelly — the scales are there to calibrate, not condemn; the truth, when you let it land, is usually less terrible than the effort of avoiding it.
justice.shadow: Harsh judgment without mercy, using fairness as a weapon, holding others to standards you won’t hold yourself.

the-hanged-man.title: The Willing Sacrifice / The Perspective Shifter
the-hanged-man.meaning: Hanging by choice — the pause that is not passivity but the most active kind of stillness; the world rearranges into a shape only visible from upside down.
the-hanged-man.shadow: Martyrdom, suffering that has become an identity, refusing to act because waiting feels like wisdom.

death.title: The Transformer / The Threshold
death.meaning: The courage to let something end completely so something new can begin completely — not a villain but a liberator; underneath the grief is spaciousness.
death.shadow: Refusing necessary endings, clinging to what is already gone, mistaking the ending for the loss.

temperance.title: The Alchemist / The Integration
temperance.meaning: Perfectly calibrated, not merely tame — blending opposites into something neither container could hold alone.
temperance.shadow: Endless moderation as avoidance of real commitment, blending everything until nothing has flavor.

the-devil.title: The Shadow / The Enchainer
the-devil.meaning: The chains hang loosely — the comfortable prison, the habit that offers relief while it takes; not shame but honesty: is the transaction actually worth it?
the-devil.shadow: Addiction, self-deception, the chain that could be slipped but hasn’t been because the comfort is familiar.

the-tower.title: The Liberator / The Necessary Collapse
the-tower.meaning: Built on a false foundation — the lightning comes to clarify, not destroy; let it fall, build from here.
the-tower.shadow: Chaos for its own sake, destruction without the willingness to rebuild, the ego that falls but refuses to learn.

the-star.title: The Healer / The Renewed
the-star.meaning: Pouring without calculating after the storm has passed — genuine hope that exists on the other side of pain, not in spite of it.
the-star.shadow: False hope, spiritual bypassing, using optimism to avoid the hard work of recovery.

the-moon.title: The Dreamer / The Illusionist
the-moon.meaning: Illuminates without explaining — dream logic that knows more than it can say; not everything that is true can be proven, not every fear is a warning.
the-moon.shadow: Confusion mistaken for depth, fear that pretends to be intuition, the subconscious running the show unexamined.

the-sun.title: The Child / The Radiant
the-sun.meaning: Does not ask permission to shine — pure joy that comes not from circumstances being perfect but from the self being fully expressed.
the-sun.shadow: Performance of joy, the need for constant validation, brightness that refuses to acknowledge shadow.

judgement.title: The Awakening / The Call
judgement.meaning: Being called, not judged — rising not because of a sentence but because the summons has finally been heard; the old story releases its grip.
judgement.shadow: Guilt that won’t release, holding others to an accounting that serves resentment more than justice.

the-world.title: The Integrator / The Complete
the-world.meaning: The end of the journey and the beginning of a new spiral — earned lightness; whole, capable, free within the circle that used to be a cage.
the-world.shadow: Resting on past achievement instead of continuing, confusing completion with arrival.

ace-of-wands.title: The Spark / The First Flame
ace-of-wands.meaning: The moment before the thing has a name — pure generative impulse, the body’s yes before the mind has reviewed the proposal.
ace-of-wands.shadow: Creative energy ignited but not yet directed — the match that lights everything without knowing what it’s building.

two-of-wands.title: The Planner / The Horizon-Gazer
two-of-wands.meaning: Standing at the edge of what you’ve built and looking toward what you haven’t yet reached — the future is genuinely available.
two-of-wands.shadow: Mistaking the map for the journey — holding the globe of possibility without ever setting foot on the ground.

three-of-wands.title: The Visionary / The Long View
three-of-wands.meaning: Ships already on the water, vision already in motion — the satisfaction of watching what you dared to start actually move.
three-of-wands.shadow: Expansion without roots — ambition that has left the ground it grew in.

four-of-wands.title: The Celebrant / The Homecoming
four-of-wands.meaning: Genuine arrival — something has been completed or begun that deserves to be marked; you are allowed to feel this.
four-of-wands.shadow: A celebration you can’t fully enter because you’re still watching for what might go wrong.

five-of-wands.title: The Combatant / The Friction-Field
five-of-wands.meaning: The productive friction of strong wills that have not yet found their synthesis — not all conflict is wrong, but this one needs direction.
five-of-wands.shadow: Conflict for its own sake — the energy that manufactures opposition when none is needed.

six-of-wands.title: The Victor / The Recognized
six-of-wands.meaning: A moment of genuine, earned recognition — you did something and it worked; you are allowed to ride through the gate.
six-of-wands.shadow: The identity that cannot exist without applause.

seven-of-wands.title: The Defender / The Stand-Taker
seven-of-wands.meaning: Holding the high ground under real pressure — staying with your position because it is genuinely yours.
seven-of-wands.shadow: Defensiveness that has become permanent posture.

eight-of-wands.title: The Arrow / The Swift Current
eight-of-wands.meaning: Everything moving at once, all in the same direction — the rare alignment of conditions, intention and momentum; now is the time to move.
eight-of-wands.shadow: Speed without aim — mistaking velocity for direction.

nine-of-wands.title: The Last Stand / The Weary Guardian
nine-of-wands.meaning: One more step from the end — you have been through the gauntlet and still you are standing.
nine-of-wands.shadow: Resilience that has become its own prison, vigilance that cannot rest.

ten-of-wands.title: The Overburdened / The One Who Carries
ten-of-wands.meaning: A weight carried a long way — the question is whether all of it still needs carrying, and whether all of it is yours.

page-of-wands.title: The Enthusiast / The First Fire
page-of-wands.meaning: Unfiltered excitement at the edge of something new — this energy doesn’t know enough to be cautious yet, and that is its gift.
page-of-wands.shadow: The beginning that never becomes a middle.

knight-of-wands.title: The Charger / The Bold Mover
knight-of-wands.meaning: Fearless forward motion with genuine courage — the question is not whether to move but whether to give the movement a true direction.
knight-of-wands.shadow: Action as avoidance — always already on to the next thing.

queen-of-wands.title: The Warm Fire / The Magnetic One
queen-of-wands.meaning: Fully alive in herself and generous with it — she doesn’t perform warmth; she is warm, and the room responds.
queen-of-wands.shadow: Charisma that has become performance, warmth conditional on being admired.

king-of-wands.title: The Visionary Leader / The Purposeful Fire
king-of-wands.meaning: Mastery in service of something larger than the self — the fire that builds rather than consumes.
king-of-wands.shadow: Vision without patience for those who move more slowly.

ace-of-cups.title: The Overflowing / The Opened Heart
ace-of-cups.meaning: The heart cracking open in the right direction — love or compassion offered without condition, the source that does not calculate what it gives.
ace-of-cups.shadow: Emotional overwhelm that has not yet found form — all feeling, no vessel.

two-of-cups.title: The Meeting / The Recognized Other
two-of-cups.meaning: The moment two people genuinely see each other — equally, cleanly, without either one diminishing.
two-of-cups.shadow: Merging as avoidance — connection that requires each person to be slightly less than themselves.

three-of-cups.title: The Circle / The Shared Joy
three-of-cups.meaning: The particular joy that only exists when it is shared — the table where everyone present makes each other more.
three-of-cups.shadow: The in-group that keeps others out, community that requires conformity.

four-of-cups.title: The Discontented / The Inward-Turned
four-of-cups.meaning: Genuine introspection at a crossroads — the necessary pause before a reorientation; the cup being offered is real.
four-of-cups.shadow: Apathy mistaken for wisdom, withdrawal that calls itself discernment.

five-of-cups.title: The Mourner / The One Facing the Spillage
five-of-cups.meaning: Real loss, genuinely felt — honest grief that deserves to be honored; the two standing cups will still be there when the mourning has had its time.
five-of-cups.shadow: Grief that has become a permanent address.

six-of-cups.title: The Memory / The Innocent Return
six-of-cups.meaning: The warmth of what was genuinely good — the past has a gift for the present, if the present does not try to become the past.
six-of-cups.shadow: The past used as escape from the present.

seven-of-cups.title: The Dreamer / The Overwhelmed Chooser
seven-of-cups.meaning: More real options than can be held — not scarcity but abundance; the gift and the challenge is the requirement to choose.
seven-of-cups.shadow: Fantasy as a full-time occupation, preferring possibility to any particular reality.

eight-of-cups.title: The Walker-Away / The One Who Leaves at Midnight
eight-of-cups.meaning: The courageous walk into the unknown — leaving not from defeat but because what was once enough is no longer.
eight-of-cups.shadow: Leaving as a lifestyle, exiting before things can require more depth.

nine-of-cups.title: The Fulfilled / The Satisfied One
nine-of-cups.meaning: Genuine satisfaction — the wish already granted; the only question is whether you will let yourself receive it.

ten-of-cups.title: The Fulfilled Home / The Real Happiness
ten-of-cups.meaning: The emotional inheritance you always deserved — belonging, warmth, people who are genuinely glad you exist.
ten-of-cups.shadow: The performance of happiness that papers over what is actually happening.

page-of-cups.title: The Dreamy Messenger / The Emotional Beginner
page-of-cups.meaning: The surprise of the heart — a feeling that arrives from nowhere and speaks; the willingness to be moved without knowing why.
page-of-cups.shadow: Feeling as performance, sensitivity displayed rather than felt.

knight-of-cups.title: The Romantic / The One Who Follows the Heart
knight-of-cups.meaning: Riding toward what is beautiful and true — the courage of the romantic is real, even when the romance is impractical.
knight-of-cups.shadow: Idealism that cannot survive contact with reality.

queen-of-cups.title: The Emotional Depth / The Compassionate Container
queen-of-cups.meaning: The rarest kind of listening — a presence that makes others feel held, by someone deeply connected to her own interior life.
queen-of-cups.shadow: Empathy without boundaries, absorbing everyone’s feelings until nothing of yourself is left.

king-of-cups.title: The Feeling Authority / The Master of the Interior
king-of-cups.meaning: Maturity in the realm of feeling — the ability to feel deeply without being swept away, to lead from a place both warm and clear.
king-of-cups.shadow: Emotional control that has become manipulation.

ace-of-swords.title: The Breakthrough / The First Truth
ace-of-swords.meaning: The clarity that arrives like a blade parting fog — sudden, total, uncommissioned; the kind of knowing that cannot be unknown.

two-of-swords.title: The Stalemate / The Blindfolded One
two-of-swords.meaning: Holding two impossibilities in balance — the real question is not which sword to drop but whether you can bear to look.
two-of-swords.shadow: The decision delayed until it makes itself.

three-of-swords.title: The Heartbreak / The Honest Wound
three-of-swords.meaning: The clean cut of genuine heartbreak — nothing is wrong with this pain; it means something real was here.
three-of-swords.shadow: Grief made permanent, the swords left in place.

four-of-swords.title: The Resting Sword / The Necessary Retreat
four-of-swords.meaning: Deliberate, strategic stillness — rest as an act of self-knowledge; the swords are set aside, not abandoned.

five-of-swords.title: The Hollow Win / The Cost of Conquest
five-of-swords.meaning: The price of victory when it has cost something that mattered — what exactly has been won here?
five-of-swords.shadow: Winning as an end in itself.

six-of-swords.title: The Crossing / The One Moving Through
six-of-swords.meaning: The slow ferry across difficult water — not triumphant, but real; you are being carried toward what comes next.

seven-of-swords.title: The Strategist / The One Slipping Away
seven-of-swords.meaning: Strategic action where direct confrontation would cost too much — the question is what you are trying to get away with.

eight-of-swords.title: The Self-Bound / The One Who Can Leave
eight-of-swords.meaning: Bound by perception, not by fact — the bindings loosen the moment you stop believing they are permanent.
eight-of-swords.shadow: The prison that requires the prisoner’s cooperation.

nine-of-swords.title: The Night Mind / The 3am Voice
nine-of-swords.meaning: The gap between the fear and the fact — the suffering is genuine, but its source is the mind feeding on itself.
nine-of-swords.shadow: The catastrophe that lives only in the mind.

ten-of-swords.title: The Final Collapse / The Bottom That Holds
ten-of-swords.meaning: The bottom has been reached — what is over is completely over, and that is the ground the next thing grows from.
ten-of-swords.shadow: Staying fallen because getting up would mean it actually happened.

page-of-swords.title: The Curious Mind / The Vigilant Beginner
page-of-swords.meaning: The delight of a new idea — sharp, fast, unafraid to ask the question no one else has thought to ask.

knight-of-swords.title: The Charger / The Relentless Mind
knight-of-swords.meaning: Absolute commitment to a direction — the question is whether the destination was named before the charge began.
knight-of-swords.shadow: Speed and force without the pause that separates courage from recklessness.

queen-of-swords.title: The Clear Eye / The One Who Will Not Be Fooled
queen-of-swords.meaning: Sees without distortion, speaks without cruelty — the truth delivered with just enough warmth to be received.

king-of-swords.title: The Intellectual Authority / The Ethical Mind
king-of-swords.meaning: The mind that has earned its authority — holding himself to the same standard he holds others.
king-of-swords.shadow: Law without mercy, logic used as a weapon.

ace-of-pentacles.title: The Seed of Form / The Material Beginning
ace-of-pentacles.meaning: A real, tangible opportunity — not a dream but a seed with actual growing potential, if it is planted in real ground.

two-of-pentacles.title: The Juggler / The One Keeping Everything Moving
two-of-pentacles.meaning: The skill of holding competing demands in motion — the question is whether you are juggling toward something or just to avoid dropping.
two-of-pentacles.shadow: The permanent juggle that substitutes for a decision.

three-of-pentacles.title: The Craftsperson / The Collaborative Builder
three-of-pentacles.meaning: Skill meets structure meets collaboration — what is being built is larger than any one person, and that is the point.
three-of-pentacles.shadow: Mastery that has become an ego.

four-of-pentacles.title: The Holder / The One Who Will Not Let Go
four-of-pentacles.meaning: The understandable desire for stability — the question is whether the grip has become so tight the held thing cannot breathe.

five-of-pentacles.title: The Excluded / The One in the Cold
five-of-pentacles.meaning: Real difficulty, genuinely felt — the window is lit and the door is not locked, but you have not yet looked up.

six-of-pentacles.title: The Giver / The Balance of Exchange
six-of-pentacles.meaning: Resources moving from where there is more to where there is less — is this freely given, and freely received?

seven-of-pentacles.title: The Assessor / The Long-View Tender
seven-of-pentacles.meaning: The honest pause midway through a long effort — not to quit, but to look at what has grown and calibrate.

eight-of-pentacles.title: The Apprentice / The One Doing the Work
eight-of-pentacles.meaning: Skill built through repetition rather than inspiration — craft is the accumulated honesty of showing up.

nine-of-pentacles.title: The Self-Made / The One Who Has Arrived in Themselves
nine-of-pentacles.meaning: The pleasure of a life built by your own hand — the satisfaction of having made something real and standing inside it.

ten-of-pentacles.title: The Legacy / The Enduring Structure
ten-of-pentacles.meaning: The multigenerational view — what is being built here that will outlast the building of it.

page-of-pentacles.title: The Student / The Practical Dreamer
page-of-pentacles.meaning: Holding the coin of a new opportunity up to the light — genuinely curious and willing to learn; the beginning of mastery.
page-of-pentacles.shadow: Perpetual preparation as a way of avoiding beginning.

knight-of-pentacles.title: The Reliable One / The Slow and Certain Mover
knight-of-pentacles.meaning: The unglamorous, necessary work of showing up in the same direction every day — not the hero, but the one who gets there.

queen-of-pentacles.title: The Practical Nurturer / The One Who Makes Things Real
queen-of-pentacles.meaning: Care that makes itself felt in real and physical ways — the practical love that asks what is needed and then provides it.

king-of-pentacles.title: The Builder / The Reliable Provider
king-of-pentacles.meaning: Mastery in the material world — someone who has built something durable and knows how to steward it.
